description: This file defines the main application structure and app delegate for an iOS app built with SwiftUI. It handles application lifecycle events, background tasks, push notifications, and watch prompt interactions. It also includes functions for scheduling notifications, handling notification actions, and routing user interactions to the app model.

classes.name: OpenClawAppDelegate
classes.description: App delegate managing notifications, background tasks, and lifecycle events for the iOS application.

methods.name: application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:)
methods.description: Initializes background tasks, notification center delegate, and remote notifications registration.

methods.name: application(_:didRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithDeviceToken:)
methods.description: Handles successful registration for remote notifications, updating the app model with the device token.

methods.name: application(_:didFailToRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithError:)
methods.description: Logs failure to register for remote notifications.

methods.name: application(_:didReceiveRemoteNotification:fetchCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles incoming remote notifications, triggering background wake or deferring based on app state.

methods.name: scenePhaseChanged(_:)
methods.description: Schedules background refresh when app moves to background.

methods.name: registerBackgroundWakeRefreshTask()
methods.description: Registers background wake refresh task with the system.

methods.name: scheduleBackgroundWakeRefresh(afterSeconds:reason:)
methods.description: Schedules a background task to wake the app after a delay with a reason.

methods.name: handleBackgroundWakeRefresh(task:)
methods.description: Executes background refresh logic, including rescheduling and notifying the app model.

methods.name: userNotificationCenter(_:willPresent:withCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles presentation options for incoming notifications, especially for watch prompts.

methods.name: userNotificationCenter(_:didReceive:withCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Routes notification responses, especially actions from watch prompts, for processing.
